episode_goal: Establish the memory exchange rule and force Nia to choose rescue over certainty.
entry_state: Nia hides her ability to hear final memories; Rowan tracks supernatural memory losses alone.
central_conflict: A patient can be revived, but Rowan warns that the attempt will erase his only memory of the entity's face.
protagonist_decision: Nia performs the rescue despite the warning and records everything Rowan can describe first.
reveal: The revived patient carries the same silver emergency tag Rowan remembers from a century earlier.
emotional_movement: Professional focus → impossible fear → morally certain action.
exit_state: The patient lives; Rowan loses the entity's face but gains Nia's recorded description.
cliffhanger: Rowan's journal develops a blank page bearing Nia's name.

episode_goal: Prove that memory loss can alter trust, not just information.
entry_state: Nia and Rowan investigate the tag; Rowan knows his journal predicts a loss involving Nia.
central_conflict: Another emergency begins while Rowan forgets why Nia is safe to approach.
protagonist_decision: Nia lets Rowan hear her own recorded account before acting, then enters the rescue without his approval.
reveal: The entity can target relational memories when the pair resists it.
payoff_refs: Partial payoff of `SR-S2`: the blank page predicts relational erasure.
exit_state: Rowan no longer remembers meeting Nia, but believes the evidence she preserved.
cliffhanger: He repeats “remember me forward,” a phrase Nia has never told him.

episode_goal: Reveal the entity's offer and make Rowan reject preservation at another person's cost.
entry_state: Trust depends on records and renewed choices rather than shared memory.
central_conflict: The entity offers to restore Rowan if Nia allows one marked patient to die.
protagonist_decision: Nia prepares the rescue while Rowan destroys his private archive so it cannot be used as leverage.
reveal: The silver tags are anchors that route memories to the entity.
payoff_refs: Partial payoff of `SR-S1`: the tag's function is exposed.
exit_state: The patient survives; Rowan loses most autobiographical memory; Nia keeps only their jointly verified facts.
cliffhanger: Nia discovers her own earliest memory now inside the patient's tag.

episode_goal: Resolve the exchange through shared agency rather than restoring the old status quo.
entry_state: The entity holds Nia's earliest memory and Rowan's archive; both understand the tag mechanism.
central_conflict: Breaking every tag would free the memories but erase Rowan completely.
protagonist_decision: Nia proposes a shared living archive, and Rowan knowingly accepts a future identity not guaranteed by his past.
reveal: The exchange persists only while one person bears the loss alone.
emotional_movement: Anticipatory loss → reciprocal trust → bittersweet renewal.
exit_state: The entity loses control; not all memories return, but Nia and Rowan can create and preserve new shared memories.
cliffhanger: Rowan opens a fresh journal and asks Nia to tell him the first thing he chose, not the first thing he forgot.
